description: Compute the canonical ptpge-cfs/1 serialization and SHA-256 fingerprint of a resolved product configuration (SD-0040) — the vendor-neutral identity used as quote/order/cache key. Returns both profiles in strict containment spec ⊂ request: 'spec' = the manufacturable artifact, commercial cluster excluded; 'request' = spec plus the commercial cluster — the variables under variables/order/ (quantity, lead-time, delivery-method, incoterm; SD-0040) without a vendor. An 'offer' is a request plus variables/order/vendor, one per vendor (SD-0108). Transaction data (print-ready file, delivery date, price) is keyed BY the request fingerprint and never hashed into it. SD-0083: the input is validated first and an identity is issued ONLY for a valid, complete configuration — every required axis of the product bound (or envelope-implied where the envelope offers one value; those are written into the identity) and every surface one of the bound setup's faces. Otherwise the result is error=not_fingerprintable with the validator's needs_disambiguation: put each question to the user verbatim, bind the answer, call again. Never guess a missing axis.

unit.description: custom-width / custom-height only — converted to mm before the identity.

visuals.description: Also return markSvg (the ptpge-mark/1 recognition mark) and qrSvg (QR encoding the resolver permalink) per profile. Off by default to keep payloads small.

name: ptpge_fingerprint
title: Fingerprint a configuration
